_readme: Time-boxed exceptions for scripts/audit-gate.mjs. An entry here suppresses one
advisory in one dependency tree until its expiry date, and not one day longer:
the gate FAILS on a past expiry, it does not warn. Renewal is a commit that
restates the argument, which is the only mechanism that has ever kept an
Every field is required and the gate rejects the file if one is missing.
id            GHSA identifier as it appears in the audit output
tree          one of: pnpm-workspace | site-bubble | discord-bridge
severity      as reported, so a silent escalation is visible in the diff
reason        why the fix is not being taken NOW (usually: it is a major bump)
reachability  why the vulnerable code path is not reachable from shipped code
owner         a person, not a team
expires       YYYY-MM-DD, at most 92 days out
reachability is the field that matters. If you cannot write a specific,
falsifiable sentence there, the honest move is to take the upgrade.

entries.reason: Fix is react-router >=8.3.0, and react-router 8 declares peerDependencies react >=19.2.7. apps/app and apps/admin are on react 18.3.1, as is apps/web through @astrojs/react, so taking it means a React 18 -> 19 migration across all three apps. Staying on react-router-dom 6.30.x is the worse trade: that line carries GHSA-jjmj-jmhj-qwj2 (open redirect leading to XSS) with no fix in 6.x at all, plus GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6 and GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg, all of which 7.18.2 already closes. One unreachable high beats three reachable moderates.
entries.reachability: Not reachable. GitHub's own advisory text says it only affects applications using the unstable RSC APIs. apps/app and apps/admin use react-router in declarative mode only: BrowserRouter in apps/app/src/App.tsx and apps/admin/src/main.tsx, plus Routes, Route, Link, Navigate, useNavigate, useLocation, useParams and useSearchParams. Neither app imports any unstable_ export, react-router/rsc, createCallServer or matchRSCServerRequest, and both ship as static client-side SPA bundles with no server, so there is no request for a CSRF bypass to act on. Falsifiable: grep for unstable_ or /rsc under apps/app/src and apps/admin/src returns nothing.
